findings.summary: The new Remove block affordance says either party may remove a block, but the operation and the Block entity invariant both say only the blocker can.
findings.evidence: affordance effects: "Either party to the block may remove it" vs operation.block.remove preconditions: "Caller is the blocker", failure: "Any caller other than the blocker is denied"; entity.Block invariant: "Only the blocker can remove it"

findings.summary: The affordance precondition offers Remove block whenever any block exists between the two accounts, so the blocked party would see a control the operation always denies.
findings.evidence: affordance preconditions: "A block exists between the owner and this contact's linked account"; failure only: "Not available when no block exists"; operation.block.remove: "Caller is the blocker"
